newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Settlement struck with China's Unipec - Lehman HK.
newsitem.headline: Settlement struck with China's Unipec - Lehman HK.

text.p: Lehman Brothers' Hong Kong office said Monday the company had settled a legal dispute concerning foreign currency trading with state-owned China International United Petroleum and Chemicals Co. Ltd. (Unipec).
Details of the settlement were not immediately available.
A source at Unipec in Beijing confirmed that a private agreement had been reached with Lehman.
"The matter has been solved ... it's a private deal," the source said, but declined to disclose details.

Lehman had filed a $44 million lawsuit in New York against Unipec in November 1994, claiming that the Chinese oil trader had reneged on obligations over certain foreign exchange and swap transactions after incurring losses.
Unipec said Lehman had taken orders from certain Hong Kong firms regarding the transactions but denied having any affiliation with them.
